notes: It is evident from the above table that the highest number of inmates per jail official
was reported from Haryana (17), Bihar & Delhi (16 each) and Gujarat (10). Himachal
Pradesh, Nagaland, Tripura, and Daman & Diu reported having only one correctional staff
for 699, 910, 939 and 45 inmates respectively. Uttar Pradesh reported 4286 inmates per
correctional staff followed by Madhya Pradesh (3902), Orissa (2731) and Delhi (1502). The
lowest 45 inmates per correctional staff was reported from Daman & Diu which indicate
that the immates were well attended for their reformation. Medical Staff is also very
important constituent of the total strength. On the basis of medical staff strength, we may
assess the health care services available to inmates in prisons. Maharashtra reported highest
number of 743 inmates per medical staff followed by Orissa (607), Gujarat (414) and Bihar
(405) during the year 1999. Manipur (14) reported least number of inmates per medical staff.
